notes.title: Update 1.7.6 version
notes.notes:
Hello Urbekites,
Thank you very much for all the feedback, I improved a lot of mistakes and added other things you asked for. If you find mistakes or things to improve, don't hesitate to tell me, thanks!

Here is the list of changes for the 1.7.6 version. Changes are for main game (🔶) and train DLC

[h2]🔶Main game[/h2]
[list]
[*] Zoom works better now
[*] When destroying half of an urban forest, an advanced park does not magically appear
[/list]

[h2]Train DLC[/h2]

[h3]Fixed bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Production of train stations is displayed and works immediately
[*] Trains no longer overlap as much, if that happens, one will stop to let the other one keep moving
[*] Train tutorial loads correctly when loading a game.
[*] Little dessert cruiser no longer sticks together
[*] Two-storey fishermen's houses now get train bonuses
[*] Desert goods industry now gets train bonus correctly
[*] It is no longer shown that the train bridges were unlocked on the archipelago map
[/list]

[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] There is now a hotkey for building train-related buildings, it is the letter T and can be changed like the other keys.
[*] New train line replaces old one when building on top of it (no need to press ALT)
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stations now have a limit to the bonus they can give. The smallest station can max increase the production of a construction by 50%, while the largest station can max increase the production of a construction by 300%.
[*] The largest station now has a larger radius.
[/list]

notes.title: Discount -40%. New update: Anarchism and authority
notes.notes:
Hello Urbekites,

Explore new horizons in Urbek with the latest update, "Anarchism and Authority"! Now, you can craft your city according to your vision, whether embracing the principles of anarchism or authority. It's your city, your rules. Unleash your creativity today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39262571/0691c063305ecc7602680d96d78a8b312eeaad93.png[/img]

Here the list of new buildings
[list]
[*] Occupied industry
[*] Community garden
[*] Ecovillage
[*] Radio station
[*] National radio
[*] Pirate radio
[*] Bicycle parking
[*] Occupied building
[*] Association
[*] Give-away shop
[*] Privated community
[*] Ministry of Security
[*] Security camera
[*] Police headquarters
[*] Advanced police Headquarters
[*] Checkpoint
[*] Prison
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39262571/f57b89c5aecde4d4faadd7b0ce736d7e78dfc3a2.png[/img]

Moreover, 12 new policies

[list]
[*] More police
[*] Special forces
[*] Police drones
[*] Religious authority
[*] Prison labour
[*] Heavy prison labour
[*] Forced labour in the fields
[*] Cameras with AI
[*] Incentivise bicycles
[*] Banks in the mall
[*] Improve prison conditions
[*] Overcrowded prisons
[/list]

Finally, a new mechanic that there is [b]repression[/b], a new variable produced by prisons or security cameras, decreases the leisure demands of the constructions. So you may prefer to repress the population rather than give them leisure.

Many thanks to the discord community who helped me a lot in defining what builds to do and giving me ideas. If you want to be part of Urbek, enter to Urbek's discord:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/HyJSDDn][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39262571/c68e33a949adffa14b71a4c36aae9be0389d88bf.png[/img]

[/list]

[list]

[/list]

[*] The advanced ferry is now pre-unlocked earlier, so that players can see that there is such a possibility later on.
[*] The Open Pit Coal Technological Mine no longer requires at least 1 Faculty of Engineering, so it is not abandoned when the faculty is upgraded.
[/list]

notes.title: Release alpha v0.3.0
notes.notes:
At last, a new version of the game. This time with a lot of new stuff (including an easter egg). 

[h2][b]New[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] 20+ more buildings
[*] 3 more resources (high skilled work, goods and steel)
[*] Ambient music
[*] Easter Egg (try to find it!)
[*] New perspective camera
[*] Credits on game
[/list]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39262571/7810c7919170cf2f04f018b512687c18e5c4d4ee.png[/img]

[h2][b]Bugs[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Solved: The camera couldn't access the top side of the map when you rotate view 180°.
[*] Solved: football field said 1 beauty, but provides 2
[*] Trees reached more than 100 of wood, now they reach only 100 as expected
[*] Solved many problems with influence area
[*] Now it is indicated what kind of water it is (sea, river or pond)
[*] The first road built can now be destroyed
[/list]

[h2][b]Graphic[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Isometric/perspective view
[*] The exploitation rate of the constructions is shown
[*] It is possible to see how the global variables are obtained
[*] Date is displayed
[/list]

[h2][b]Mechanics[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] If game notices that you are in problems the first steps of the game it gives you more wood and a pop up message "dont do that again".
[*] When demolishing a building bigger than 1x1, the other tiles become automaticly the root (farms become pre-farms, etc)
[*] Now the water is differentiated if it's river, sea or artificial water. So you can not build a dock in an artificial pond.
[/list]

[h2][b]Balance[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Minimarket and other buildings need to be next to the road
[*] Some kind of trees has more wood than others, so forest management can be done (the forest regenerates according to the trees nearby).
[*] Coal plants produce much more energy
[*] Lumberjacks convert wood to energy instead of trees to energy.
[/list]

[h2][b]Desert[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] No changes in the desert for now (first leave the temperate biome well tempered)
[/list]
